question: KALYANKJIL's operating margin compressed because the mobile-PLI benefit expired. When does management expect the margin to normalise, and on what?
answer: The data does not contain any reference to a "mobile-PLI benefit" expiry. What management (Ramesh Kalyanaraman, Q1FY27 concall, Aug 2026) does say is that margin dilution of ~0.2%–0.3% from old-gold exchange should be negated by cash-for-gold (buying at a discount to spot), and that for the full year FY27 they expect to maintain PBT margins of the previous year. So normalisation is expected over the full FY27 on the back of cash-for-gold gaining momentum.
